# Class: `NeuralDetector`

Uses reference and detector networks to predict new droplet circles.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-neural-detection.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_neural_detection.py#L265) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `object`.

Runs OpenCV DNN inference on the CPU with raw RGB uint8 images. Accepts any number of guidance circles and returns circle/score records after duplicate suppression. Cancellation returns an empty result rather than partial detections.
